verified_from_source: n_pca_fit is used as the PCA component-count argument, not as a training-sample count.
The exact array passed to PCA.fit is X_train_raw, created by stacking all retained training waveforms.
The PCA fitting call receives a (2600, 16384) array under the recorded Q1.6 protocol.
The pre-PCA vector is a single whitened time-domain plus-polarization series; it is not a concatenation of channels or a spectrogram.
The scaler is fit on all 2600 training rows after PCA and is only transformed on validation.
derived_from_metadata: The Q1.6 cache contains 2600 training and 650 validation examples with 16 post-PCA columns.
The generation metadata records n_components=16 and n_pca_fit=64.
The first 12 train and validation component hashes match the frozen historical Q1 hashes.
assumptions: Pre-PCA storage estimates use float64, consistent with NumPy FFT processing and the persisted post-PCA array dtype; no raw pre-PCA dtype was saved.
The 2599 centered-rank value is an algebraic upper bound, not an observed numerical rank.
unknown: The effective numerical rank and singular spectrum of the original 2600 by 16384 training matrix.
Whether the first 64 principal directions are stable under train-only resampling.
Whether the thesis's reported feature matrix and training population match any Q1.6 source data.

sample_selection.selection_order: The generator retains the first 200 seeded draws per class for train, the next 50 for validation, and discards the following 100 draws per class.

pre_pca_feature_layout.numpy_stack_output: one row per event, one column per time sample

feature_blocks.name: whitened_time_samples
feature_blocks.meaning: Consecutive samples of the same 4-second whitened time series at 4096 Hz.

transformations_in_execution_order: Draw binary masses and distance from the adapter's seeded NumPy generator.
Generate the PyCBC plus-polarization time-domain waveform at 4096 Hz with the IMRPhenomPv2 approximant and 20 Hz lower cutoff.
Keep the last 16384 samples, or left-pad a shorter waveform to that length.
Apply the class-specific beyond-GR waveform injection. Most injectors modify the Fourier-domain strain; selected injectors construct a modified time-domain plus strain.
Return to time domain with irfft where the injection was performed in frequency space.
Whiten using the analytic aLIGO O3 PSD: rFFT, divide by sqrt(PSD times frequency-bin width), retain 20-1024 Hz, and inverse transform.
Normalize each whitened time series to unit L2 norm.
Treat the 16384 whitened time samples as the pre-PCA feature vector; no separate handcrafted feature extraction is applied.
Stack all retained train vectors into X_train_raw with shape (2600, 16384); stack validation separately as X_val_raw with shape (650, 16384).
Fit PCA only on X_train_raw, with n_components=64 and random_state=42. Here 64 is a component count, not a count of rows passed to fit.
Transform train and validation, retaining only the first 16 PCA scores.
Fit MinMaxScaler(feature_range=(-1, 1)) on training PCA scores only; transform validation with that scaler and clip both splits to [-1, 1].

pre_pca_features.shape_derivation: LIGOPCAAdapter defaults duration=4.0 s and sample_rate=4096 Hz; _generate_base_waveform sets n_target=int(duration*sample_rate), and _whiten_strain returns irfft(..., n=n), preserving that length. The runtime adapter check yielded 16384 samples.
pre_pca_features.dtype_basis: NumPy FFT pipeline and persisted PCA arrays are float64; pre-PCA arrays were not persisted for direct dtype inspection.
pre_pca_features.regenerable_from_source_and_seed: Potentially, by rerunning the PyCBC generator with the frozen source, dependency versions, and seed; not attempted in this audit.

pca_audit.n_pca_fit_semantics: The value 64 is passed as PCA(n_components=n_fit); it is not the number of examples used in PCA.fit.
pca_audit.solver_selection_basis: In scikit-learn 1.7.2, max(shape)>500 and 64 < 0.8*min(shape), so PCA(svd_solver='auto') selects the randomized solver.
pca_audit.class_stratification: Yes; all 200 generated training rows for each of the 13 classes are stacked, in class blocks.
pca_audit.normalization_before_pca: Per-event L2 normalization after PSD whitening; this is not feature-wise standardization.
pca_audit.bound_reason: rank(centered X_train) <= min(2600 - 1, 16384); 2599 is an upper bound, not an observed rank.
pca_audit.rank_lower_bound_caveat: The stored explained-variance ratios for PC1-PC16 are positive, but the original singular values and a tolerance-based rank diagnostic are unavailable.

numerical_stability_diagnostics.reason: The original centered training matrix and fitted PCA object were not persisted.

cached_data_integrity.reproduction_limit: The cache contains only scaled 16-component projections and labels; raw features, PCA mean/components, and scaler state are absent.

variance_analysis.available_curve_scope: PC1-PC16 only; these ratios were retained from the train-fitted 64-component PCA.
variance_analysis.interpretation: The plot is intentionally limited to the 16 persisted ratios. High cumulative variance does not establish that later low-variance components lack class-discriminative information.

historical_reproducibility.sign_ambiguity_handling: A future refit comparison must align each component sign (for example by the sign of the dot product between matched training-score vectors or component vectors) before comparing scores. Exact hashes without this alignment can reject equivalent PCA solutions.

thesis_methodology_comparison.source: boullosa_dapena_oscar_deposito_ordinaria (1) (3).pdf, printed pages 21-22 and Appendix Table C.2 (printed page 115)
thesis_representation_described: Calibrated frequency-domain detector strain downloaded from GWOSC.
Noise PSD estimated using Welch on a 256-second off-source stretch.
STFT spectrogram using a 0.5-second Tukey window and 50% overlap.
Concatenation with matched-filter log-likelihood at the MAP estimate and its first-order phase-space gradient.
Feature dimension described as O(10^3); PCA fitted on training data.
q1_6_representation: Synthetic PyCBC IMRPhenomPv2 plus-polarization waveforms with class-specific injections.
Analytic aLIGO O3 PSD whitening and per-event L2 normalization.
One 16384-sample time-domain vector per event; no STFT or matched-filter statistics.
No detector noise; 2600 synthetic training examples, balanced over 13 classes.
thesis_methodology_comparison.comparison_conclusion: The percentages are not directly comparable because the feature construction and data sources differ. The thesis section does not specify the training-example count, feature-wise standardization before PCA, or the exact PCA solver.
thesis_methodology_comparison.repository_code_caveat: The LIGOPCAAdapter module docstring cites a 95.3% table and calls it inter-class variance, while the thesis's Table C.2 describes 95.2% cumulative explained variance. The Q1.6 PCA call is ordinary unsupervised PCA on X_train_raw; class labels are not passed to PCA.fit.

scaling_feasibility.feasibility_basis: Each target dimension is below the 16384 original features, the 2599 centered-training rank upper bound, and the existing 64-component PCA fit budget.
scaling_feasibility.rank_condition: These are structurally feasible, but the missing full training matrix means the actual numerical rank is not verified to be at least 32.
required_pipeline_changes: Create a separately versioned train/validation cache retaining at least 32 PCA scores; do not overwrite the historical 16-component cache.
Use the same frozen waveform protocol, class order, sample draws, and train-only PCA fit; set retained n_components to at least 32 (the existing n_pca_fit=64 budget is sufficient).
Persist the train-fitted PCA mean/components and scaler state, or persist the pre-PCA train/validation matrices, to make later projections and reproducibility audits possible.
Persist explained-variance ratios and numerical-rank diagnostics for every fitted component, not only the retained prefix.
Record new dataset hashes and a new immutable manifest; verify the first 12/16 components against historical data after sign alignment.

A_preserve_historical_fit.proposal: Preserve the exact historical 2600-row training sample, preprocessing, solver, seed, and PCA basis; retain components 1-32.
A_preserve_historical_fit.current_artifact_feasibility: Cannot extend from the 16-column cache because raw features and the fitted PCA object (including components 17-64) were not saved.
A_preserve_historical_fit.reproduction_path: Would require rerunning the frozen waveform generator or recovering an external copy of the raw training matrix, then refitting with the original settings and retaining 32.
A_preserve_historical_fit.tradeoff: Best comparability to Q1.6 if the exact input matrix and software environment can be reproduced; bitwise identity is not guaranteed by the current artifacts.

B_refit_on_all_2600_training_examples.proposal: Fit PCA on all 2600 training rows and retain 32, then transform validation without refitting.
B_refit_on_all_2600_training_examples.current_artifact_feasibility: Also requires the raw train/validation vectors or regeneration; the 16-dimensional cache is insufficient.
B_refit_on_all_2600_training_examples.tradeoff: Explicit and leakage-safe. If the raw matrix, preprocessing, solver, random state, and versions are identical to A, B is effectively the same refit and not a distinct statistical design. Changing any of these creates a new basis/condition.

pca32_approach_comparison.recommendation: If PCA32 is later approved, use all 2600 historical training rows and the frozen Q1.6 preprocessing/seed/solver settings, retain 32, and treat this as a reproducibility refit of A. Verify sign-aligned train/validation prefixes before issuing a new immutable cache manifest. Neither approach was executed.

memory_estimates.estimate_caveat: The floor accounts for the generator's retained waveform lists, stacked train/validation arrays, and one centered PCA training copy; randomized-SVD workspace, BLAS buffers, allocator overhead, and Python objects add to peak RSS. Reserve more than this estimate.

recommendation.sequence: After producing and integrity-checking a separate 32-component train/validation cache, evaluate 20, 24, and 32 components as pre-registered conditions; retain 16 as the baseline.
recommendation.do_not_infer: Do not infer that components after 16 are useless from variance ratios alone, and do not treat the 2599 upper bound as the measured effective rank.
